problem: POEM MAP boot may start an asynchronous FIELD NOW preload. If a human/API explicitly parses a newer local source before that fetch returns, the stale preload could later overwrite the newer source and break source-bound focus RETURN.
cause: No source-selection epoch separated an older async preload from a newer explicit parse.
delta: loadFieldNow keeps the source epoch guard, but stale/cancelled preload returns null rather than false; boot falls back to DEMO only on an actual fetch failure (ok===false), so one stale load cannot overwrite/cancel a newer valid load through the fallback path.
law: EXPLICIT NEWER SOURCE > STALE ASYNC PRELOAD, and STALE/CANCELLED ≠ UNAVAILABLE. Cancellation must not trigger fallback mutation.
preserves: FIELD NOW preload when no newer source claim occurs

regression.probe: public-surface critical browser smoke: POEM MAP focus return /__smoke/poem-map-focus-return
regression.expected: fixed local source → MAP → L1T2 → full reload → same source_key + mode + selected token
regression.prior_failure: source_key text-local:35:* was replaced by CURRENT-derived text-local:4261:* before reload

static: stale epoch returns null, not false
boot DEMO fallback runs only for ok===false
existing critical browser smoke /__smoke/poem-map is the exact competing-load regression proof

residue: No new mode/store/workflow; focus-return/source-key behavior is unchanged.
The repair distinguishes cancellation from availability only.
